feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 4 August 2026 4:09pm
items.description:
##Yesterday##

Cloudy at first with hill and coastal mist, but outbreaks of rain will die out later in the morning with sunny intervals developing for the afternoon and evening and only isolated showers. Dry overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

East or SE 15, veering South 10-15 during morning, increasing South or SW 20 in places later in day. Veering West or SW overnight, increasing 15-20 later, 20-25 in places.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor at times in morning, then becoming good thereafter. Hill fog, extensive at first, clearing later in day.


##Comments##

Strong winds in places later.


##Today##

Sunny/ clear intervals and scattered showers, possibly longer spell of rain for a time later in day, then becoming dry overnight. Windy.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-3


##Wind Speed##

25


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

West or SW 15-20, 20-25 in places, increasing 20-25 by about midday, 25-30 gusts 40 in places, 45 in a few of the most exposed spots, then gradually veering and decreasing West or NW 15-20 late in day/ overnight, still 20-25 in places.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers. Patchy hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds.


##Tomorrow##

Sunny/ clear spells and scattered showers. Brisk winds at first, but easing steadily.


##Temperature##

##Wind##

##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##
